- immediate point-of-contact for evidence handover (secure SFTP or equivalent)
- confirmation of whether Redwood will initiate customer notification per the DPA timelines
- any contractual constraints on data we should redact before transfer (PII minimization)

Happy to jump on a call now — ops on standby.

— Dan / CloudEdge Ops
